remarks: This light-filled in-town apartment puts you right in the middle of everything that makes Westport easy and enjoyable. Set just above the river, the unit offers peaceful water views while keeping daily life effortless and walkable. Step outside and you are immediately connected to the best of downtown. Morning coffee is seconds away with Starbucks right outside your door. Dinner plans, shopping, and errands are simple with Bedford Square just a short walk away, home to popular restaurants, boutiques, and everyday conveniences. Inside, the space is clean, bright, and efficient. The kitchen features wood cabinetry, stainless appliances, and a classic tile backsplash. Large windows bring in natural light and reinforce the connection to the river and surrounding neighborhood.
